freeze.frozen_file_sha256: recorded in the freeze commit message

nature: new predeclaration; not a reconstruction of the absent c5ad968 predeclaration
status_effect: none: no DAY-25B output can change V2-MOM status, the DAY-22 lockdown, or the forward-OOS plan (protocol §13.C, §16)
evidence_label: robustness diagnostic on reused historical data — not independent or forward evidence
universe_order_rule: ascending ASCII (Python sorted) of config.day_universe.FROZEN_DAY_UNIVERSE; used for enumeration, D3 keys and all tie-breaks

common.b1_sub: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the ranking-universe symbols with a bar at the segment's first open; same engine, accounting and lambda rule; same cost scenario as the compared variant
common.active_return_annualised: CAGR(strategy) - CAGR(comparator), same sessions and cost; CAGR = (E_T/E_0)^(252/N) - 1; used in D1, D2, D3, D4c, D6, D7
common.preflight: D6 integrity check is a separate stage executed before any D1-D7 computation; any cagr or ending_equity mismatch aborts the entire DAY-25B process, no D1-D7 result is created and the run is not marked successful; the preflight record is kept separately from diagnostic results; the exact-equality requirement is never relaxed automatically, including when the environment fingerprint differs; a passing preflight does not authorize the diagnostics
common.determinism: byte-identical outputs on re-run; only randomness is the D3 seeded subset list

D1_leave_one_symbol_out.universe: 25 minus one symbol (ranking and holding only; prices not masked)

D2_remove_top2_abs_pnl.ranking: per segment, |Result.flows| (= symbol_pnl_contribution) of the frozen full-universe 5 bps run of that segment, descending; ties by universe order; top 2

algorithm: for each draw: keys[i] = bitgen.random_raw() for i = 0..24 in universe_order (25 uint64, consumed in that order)
subset = the 20 tickers with the smallest keys; equal keys broken by universe order; stored in universe order
no replacement within a subset (20 distinct tickers by construction)
a subset equal as a set to an already accepted subset is discarded (counted); drawing continues on the same stream
stop at 300 distinct accepted subsets; subset n is the n-th accepted
D3_random_subsets.authoritative_artifact: artifacts/day25b/run/subsets.json (with SHA-256, discard count, numpy version)

D4a_calendar_year.source: existing calendar_years of the frozen full-universe run
D4a_calendar_year.active: strategy year return - B1 year return
D4a_calendar_year.known_defect: DAY-22 P1: backtest/v2/metrics.py labels 2026 'full'; corrected in the DAY-25B report layer only; metrics.py not edited

D4b_rolling_window.window_active: prod(1+r_strategy) - prod(1+r_B1) over the window; total-return difference, not annualised

D4c_leave_one_year_out.method: splice: drop year's daily returns, compound remainder, annualise by remaining N; no re-simulation

reproduction_check.stage: separate preflight stage, executed before any D1-D7 computation (including the D6 15/20 bps overrides); no diagnostic computation starts until it has completed and passed
reproduction_check.equality: exact, full float64 precision, no rounding or tolerance

on_mismatch.action: abort the entire DAY-25B process and report the discrepancy

equality_relaxation.on_environment_difference: equality requirement unchanged; fingerprint recorded and reported, never used to excuse a mismatch; a value mismatch still aborts

contents: per comparison: reference file, field, reference value and recomputed value at full precision
environment fingerprint: current distributions_sha256, Python version, numpy version

D7_single_stock_buy_and_hold.rule: B2 rule applied to each universe symbol; 100% at the segment's first open; no rebalancing

multiplicity.reporting: all rows, both segments, both costs; no variant highlighted

decision_rules.statement: no pass/fail criteria, thresholds or flags; all outputs descriptive; nothing changes V2-MOM status; no threshold may be introduced after any output exists

decisions_recorded: D1-D7 complete and final scope; no additions
D3: 300 distinct subsets of 20 of 25, seed 20261008, explicit PCG64 key algorithm, fixed universe order
research and historical holdout analysed separately
costs: 5 bps primary; 10 bps secondary for D1-D5 and D7; 15/20 bps only as D6 diagnostic overrides
subset analyses: B1-sub primary, B1 secondary
D2: top 2 by |5 bps flows| per segment; same two removed at 10 bps
F1-F5 withdrawn; outputs descriptive; no effect on V2-MOM status
frozen config/SHA, implementation, B1/B2, historical data and forward-OOS boundaries preserved

D6 integrity check is a separate preflight stage executed before any D1-D7 computation; recompute 0/5/10 bps DAY-19/21 references; exact full-precision equality of cagr and ending_equity under identical segment, data, benchmark, capital and conventions; on any cagr or ending_equity mismatch the entire DAY-25B process aborts, no D1-D7 result is created and the run is not marked successful; failure details and the environment fingerprint are recorded in artifacts/day25b/preflight/preflight_record.json separately from diagnostic results; the exact-equality requirement is never relaxed automatically, including when the environment fingerprint differs; never change frozen code, reports, configuration or reference values to force a match; a passing preflight does not authorize any DAY-25B diagnostic (frozen predeclaration, reviewed implementation and separate run authorization still required)

implementation reviewed with synthetic-fixture tests, a D3 algorithm test and a config-SHA check
